attchmntText: Newspaper Publication for Unaudited Financial Results as on 30.09.2026
voiceSummary: Raj Consumer Care Limited reported un-audited financial results for the quarter and half year ended September 30, 2026. The Board of Directors approved the results on November 05, 2026. Net profit after tax was 140.34 lakhs for the quarter ended September 30, 2026, compared to 111.30 lakhs in the previous quarter. For the half year ended September 30, 2026, net profit after tax was 251.63 lakhs. Earnings per share were 0.89 for the quarter and 1.64 for the half year. Newspaper advertisements regarding these results were published in Business Standard and Nalanda Express on November 06, 2026. Twamev Construction and Infrastructure Limited announced that its Board of Directors meeting is scheduled for November 13, 2026, to consider the un-audited financial results for the same period. The trading window for its equity shares, closed since October 01, 2026, will open 48 hours after the financial results announcement.
